reply.text:
Wanting to push harder is a fine instinct, and the way to do it is a plan, not guesswork. Here's what usually works: add a little weight or a rep to your main lifts when you finish all your sets with a couple of reps still in the tank, and keep your easy days actually easy so the hard days can be hard. Sleep and eating enough carry more of this than most people expect.

Tell me which lift or which part of the week you want to push, and I'll look at what you've logged and give you a straight answer on where there's room.
